voice_lines: CIBIL 780 hai. Phir bhi loan kam kyun mila?
Kyunki bank score ke baad aapki EMI ka bojh dekhta hai.
Example: kamai ek lakh mahina, purani EMI paintees hazaar.
Agar bank pachaas percent tak EMI maanta hai, to nayi EMI ki jagah sirf pandrah hazaar.
Score achha hai. Jagah kam hai.
items.hook: CIBIL 780. Phir bhi loan kam kyun mila?
items.broll: hand writing numbers on paper, calculator.
items.number_card: Income ₹1,00,000 · Existing EMIs ₹35,000 · Limit 50% = ₹50,000 · Room for new EMI ₹15,000 (Example. Not an offer.)
items.cta: Loan lene wale dost ko bhejo
items.caption:
Achha CIBIL score sirf pehla darwaza hai. Uske baad lender dekhta hai ki kamai ka kitna hissa pehle se EMI mein ja raha hai (FOIR: fixed obligations to income ratio). Har lender ki limit alag hoti hai; 50% sirf example hai. Follow @crednest.io — bank loan dene se pehle kya dekhta hai, roz 1 simple post.

slides.text: Property de di. Loan pakka? Nahi.
MYTH: "Property girvi rakh di, ab bank mana nahi karega."
SACH: Property sirf security hai. Bank pehle poochta hai: EMI kahan se aayegi?
Bank 3 cheezein dekhta hai: 1. Kamai aur ITR (income tax return) 2. Purani EMIs 3. Property ke kagaz aur title
Property loan ka size tay karti hai. Kamai loan ka milna tay karti hai.

slides.text: 5 EMI → 1 EMI. Poora hisaab dekho
Example: 5 alag loan. Total baaki ₹40 lakh. Mahine ki total EMI ₹1,45,000.
Agar yahi ₹40 lakh property ke against ek loan ban jaye: 11% p.a., 15 saal.
Nayi EMI: ₹45,464. Mahine ka bojh ₹99,536 kam.
Dhyan rahe: 15 saal mein total byaaj ₹41,83,498 banta hai. EMI kam, par samay lamba. Jaldi prepay karna samajhdaari hai.
Ek EMI tabhi sahi hai jab cash flow sambhle aur naya udhaar band ho.

items.caption:

voice_lines: Bank ne CC limit kyun kam ki?
Kyunki limit kagaz pe hoti hai. Paisa drawing power se milta hai.
Example: stock saath lakh, debtors chaalees lakh, creditors tees lakh.
Bacha sattar lakh. Pachees percent margin kaato.
Drawing power saadhe baavan lakh. Limit pachhattar lakh hone par bhi.

items.number_card: Stock ₹60L + Debtors ₹40L − Creditors ₹30L = ₹70L · Less 25% margin · Drawing power ₹52.5L (Limit ₹75L) (Example. Not an offer.)

CC (cash credit) limit sanction hoti hai, par har mahine ka stock statement tay karta hai ki kitna nikal sakte ho. Isse drawing power kehte hain. Margin har lender ka alag hota hai. Follow @crednest.io — bank loan dene se pehle kya dekhta hai, roz 1 simple post.

slides.text: ₹3 Cr ki property. Loan kitna banta hai?
Pehla naap, property: agar lender value ka 60% deta hai, to ceiling ₹1.8 Cr.
Doosra naap, kamai: agar aap ₹1,20,000 ki EMI utha sakte ho (11% p.a., 15 saal)…
…to loan banta hai lagbhag ₹1.06 Cr. Bank dono mein se chhota number deta hai.
Property ₹3 Cr. Ceiling ₹1.8 Cr. Mila ₹1.06 Cr. Wajah: kamai.

voice_lines: Profit hai. Phir bhi bank bole capacity kam?
Bank ek simple naap dekhta hai.
Saal mein loan chukane ke liye kitna cash bacha, aur kitna chukana hai.
Example: cash tees lakh, chukana pachees lakh. Naap aaya ek point do.
Kai lender isse zyada cushion maangte hain.
items.hook: Profit hai. Phir bhi bank bole capacity kam?
items.broll: hand on calculator next to a ledger / laptop with spreadsheet.
items.number_card: Cash available ₹30L ÷ Yearly repayment ₹25L = 1.2 (Example. Not an offer.)
items.caption:
Is naap ko DSCR kehte hain (debt service coverage ratio): saal ka cash, saal ki loan repayment se kitna guna hai. Kitna cushion chahiye, yeh lender aur loan type pe depend karta hai. Follow @crednest.io — bank loan dene se pehle kya dekhta hai, roz 1 simple post.

voice_lines: Naya project. CMA ya DPR?
DPR batata hai project kya hai, kitne ka hai, paisa kaise wapas aayega.
CMA batata hai business ke numbers: pichhle saal aur aane wale saal.
Naye project ke liye zyada lender dono maangte hain.
Pehle DPR, phir uske numbers se CMA.
